zh.eyebrow: ✦ 蚀星裂变 · 五方逐鹿
zh.hero_desc: 五大势力在裂变的星域中争夺命运，卡牌构筑、兵种相克与分支战役共同编织一部恢弘史诗。你将成为指挥官，在星尘乱流中改写帝国的终局。
zh.meta: 已有 12,847 位指挥官集结，开启新的纪元之战。
zh.factions_sub: 选择你的阵营，改写星尘纪元
zh.faction_1_desc: 以帝国法典与星轨机甲为剑，重塑旧秩序的荣光。
zh.faction_2_desc: 以黑曜与蚀星之力为旗，掀起毁灭与重生的暴风。
zh.faction_3_desc: 由海潮与神谕构成的长老文明，掌控命运的潮汐节奏。
zh.faction_4_desc: 强悍的堡垒军团以钢铁与火焰，压碎所有反对之声。
zh.faction_5_desc: 以天象与协同为根基，构筑一套最灵活的战场秩序。
zh.story_title: 纪元之卷 · 帝国裂变
zh.story_sub: 滚动展开神秘的星域背景
zh.story_quote: 「昔日的荣光已经碎裂，五方霸主各怀信念，星域将由谁来书写？」
zh.story_desc: 蚀星帝国曾是星尘之下最辉煌的文明，然而近百年内，帝国裂变与天象失序同时降临。五大势力从旧秩序中崛起，兵锋与卡牌在每一座城市、每一条星路上重新书写战争脚本。
zh.story_item_1: 星尘之下由五大势力共享天赋与宿命
zh.story_item_2: 每个势力都拥有独特的兵种与卡牌体系
zh.story_item_3: 战争不止是胜负，更是命运与信念的碰撞
zh.story_item_4: 分支战役会塑造不同的最终结局与版图
zh.features_title: 战争脚本 · 即刻演算
zh.features_sub: 卡牌构筑 · 势力羁绊 · 分支战役
zh.feature_1_desc: 400+张卡牌自由混搭，打造你的专属战术模板。
zh.feature_2_desc: 同势力组合会触发独特效果，让阵营身份更加鲜明。
zh.feature_3_desc: 每一次抉择都改变战局，推动不同的结局与命运走向。
zh.feature_4_desc: 策略克制、阵型切换与兵种特性共同构成深度战术。
zh.feature_5_desc: 实时对战中，部署时机决定成败，指挥与节奏同样重要。
zh.feature_6_desc: 竞技排名、段位晋升与头衔体系，持续推动竞争热度。
zh.footer_title: ⚔ 星尘之下 · 战争脚本
zh.footer_desc: 世界观：蚀星裂变 · 五大势力 卡牌对决

en.hero_desc: Five factions compete for destiny in the fractured starfield. Card building, unit counters, and branching campaigns weave an epic saga. Become a commander and rewrite the empire's fate amidst the stardust currents.
en.meta: 12,847 commanders have gathered to begin the new era of war.
en.factions_sub: Choose your faction, rewrite the stardust era
en.faction_1_desc: Wielding imperial codex and star-track mechs, restoring the glory of old order.
en.faction_2_desc: Raising obsidian and eclipse power as banners, unleashing storms of destruction and rebirth.
en.faction_3_desc: An elder civilization of tides and oracles, mastering the rhythm of fate's tides.
en.faction_4_desc: The fortress legion crushes all opposition with steel and flame.
en.faction_5_desc: Building the most flexible battlefield order based on celestial phenomena and coordination.
en.story_quote: "The former glory has shattered. Five overlords each hold their beliefs. Who shall write the starfield's fate?"
en.story_desc: The Eclipse Empire was once the most glorious civilization under stardust. Yet within a century, both imperial fission and celestial disorder arrived. Five factions rose from the old order, rewriting the war script across every city and star path.
en.story_item_1: Five factions share talents and destinies under stardust
en.story_item_2: Each faction has unique units and card systems
en.story_item_3: War is not just victory or defeat, but collision of fate and belief
en.story_item_4: Branching campaigns shape different final outcomes and territories
en.features_sub: Card Building · Faction Synergy · Branching Campaigns
en.feature_1_desc: Mix 400+ cards freely to create your unique tactical deck.
en.feature_2_desc: Same-faction combinations trigger unique effects, making your faction identity distinct.
en.feature_3_desc: Every choice changes the battle, pushing toward different endings and destinies.
en.feature_4_desc: Strategy counters, formation switching, and unit traits create deep tactics.
en.feature_5_desc: In real-time battles, timing is everything. Command and rhythm matter equally.
en.feature_6_desc: Competitive ranking, tier progression, and title system drive continuous competition.
en.footer_desc: Lore: Eclipse Fission · Five Factions Card Duel
